name: 植物精华软管泡沫洁面乳款
description: 深宝蓝水花体系与软管膏体，植物成分卡加规格参数表的详情长图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and scene shots, powdery-blue #E9EFF9 infographic panels, sections separated by deep royal blue #1E3A8A wavy band dividers
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright cool studio lighting about 5500K, front-top key with a large fill, crisp water-splash highlights, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: white glazed ceramic plate and matte white ceramic counter #F4F6F9, plus a neutral matte grey-white macro board #EDEDED
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep royal blue #1E3A8A or white #FFFFFF with one uppercase letterspaced English sub-line, all copy wrapped in 「」; chip labels set in white
styleLock.iconSystem: solid rounded capsule label chips and thin white droplet line-icons inside circular badges
styleLock.presentationRules: the tube kept upright or propped on a white glazed ceramic plate at a stable scale and a slight 3/4 hero angle across the set, with one diagonal display laydown, every frame composed as one complete balanced layout
noDrift: no gradients other than the fixed deep blue and powdery blue pair
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent deep-blue water-fresh skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, deep royal blue #1E3A8A, powdery-blue #E9EFF9 panels and one orange label accent #F08A24; cool neutral studio lighting about 5500K with a bright front-top key, large fill, crisp water-splash highlights and soft contact shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines with one uppercase letterspaced English sub-line and all copy wrapped in 「」; solid rounded capsule label chips and thin white droplet line-icon badges; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic panels; deep royal blue wavy band dividers between sections; the tube kept upright or propped on a white glazed ceramic plate at a stable scale and slight 3/4 hero angle; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched chip styles, no extra gradients.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，三秒建立干净清爽的第一印象

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The squeeze tube standing upright with its flat base cap resting on the surface, straight-on eye-level front view, full product visible and not clipped, the tube filling 60-70% of the frame with even clean white margins on all sides. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the tube. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

provenance.notes: 由 13 屏爆款洁面乳详情长图提炼；已剥离原品牌名与商标、官方证书与委托书原文、医学分析与统计图表、模特面容、原始文案与二维码；产品一律以 {product} 占位，成分与功效主张改为 {callout_n} 占位交由使用方填写；原证书空框墙与扫码入会页分别改写为管尾封边工艺信任镜与行动按钮收口镜，仅保留水花体系、胶囊标签芯片、植物图卡、规格表等可复用视觉语法。
